role: The eye of ender: right click on an end portal frame fills it (metadata + 4) and checks the 3x3 ring to spawn the end portal; otherwise it finds the closest stronghold and throws an EntityEnderEye toward it.

members.name: onItemUse
members.note: the frame fill, the smoke particles' itemRand draws, the ring walk over Direction offsets and the end portal placement; place.c's place_portal_frame_ok carries the ring check

members.name: onItemRightClick
members.note: the end-frame look check (throw.c looks_at_end_frame), the stronghold search and EntityEnderEye.moveTowards through projectile.c's proj_throw_ender_eye, the itemRand pitch and the stack decrement

notes: throw-items-s1 gates three eyes flying toward the stronghold (two dropping, one shattering); test_eyes.c gates the portal assembly against the oracle probe.
